vintage: ARCEP Ma connexion internet, 2026-06-30 / consolidated IRVE nightly export / ARCEP mobile sites 2026 T2

lenses.name: Fiber eligibility
lenses.description: Fiber-to-the-home eligible premises as a share of all connectable premises, ARCEP reference date 2026-06-30. Commune values are aggregated by map hex.

lenses.name: EV charge points
lenses.description: Public electric-vehicle charge points per 10,000 residents from the nightly consolidated national IRVE registry. Commune counts are aggregated by map hex; zero means no published public charge point, not missing data.

lenses.name: 4G site operators
lenses.description: Population-weighted number of mobile operators with at least one reported 4G-capable site physically located in each commune, ARCEP 2026 T2. This measures infrastructure presence and operator choice, not theoretical signal coverage.

lenses.name: 5G site presence
lenses.description: Share of residents living in communes with at least one reported 5G-capable operator site, ARCEP 2026 T2. A commune without a local site can still have signal from neighbouring communes, so this is deployment presence rather than coverage.
